utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What would you like me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring a couple extra tools and help organize the volunteers? That’d be a big help for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — if you learn what they still need for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — do you still need anything for the repair drive, or are you all set?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet—I’m still trying to pin down exactly what supplies and hands we’re short on for the repair drive. If you hear anything, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please let me know as soon as you have the date, time, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll pass them along as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. I’ll pass along the updated date, time, and repair list as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive and let you know as soon as I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Faye—I appreciate it. I’m still trying to pin down exactly what supplies and hands we’re short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my toolbox, but I keep forgetting where I set it down. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still sorting out the latest, Oren, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know more. If you can, bring a couple extra tools just in case.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest either—did we get any new volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I’m keeping track of supplies and updates. Once the latest list comes in, I’ll let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have the date, time, and repair list for the drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Rosa has it set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m waiting on the final repair list. I’ll pass along the full details as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we have the date, time, and repair list for the drive yet? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’m still getting the updated repair list together. I’ll send the final details soon.
